source_text: Quis ille quem repleat Deus spiritu quo Moysen? Non omnis loquax propheta. Spiritus sapientiae et fortitudinis opus Dei agit adversus Aegyptum vitiorum.
pass_a_gloss: Who that-one whom may-fill God with-spirit with-which Moses? Not every talkative prophet. Spirit of-wisdom and fortitude work of-God drives against Egypt of-vices.
pass_b_english: Who is filled with the Spirit that filled Moses? Not every talkative tongue. The Spirit of wisdom and might drives God’s work against Egypt — that is, against the vices that enslave the soul.
